newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius first quarter trade deficit $92 million.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius first quarter trade deficit $92 million.

text.p: Mauritius' first-quarter registered trade deficit was 2.02 billion rupees ($91.71 million), the economic planning ministry said on Tuesday.
It said in a report Mauritius exported goods worth 6.79 billion rupees compared to imports of 8.81 billion rupees in the first quarter.

"This deficit was almost at the same level as that of the corresponding quarter of 1996, 2.0 billion rupees, but 24.3-percent higher than that registered during the fourth quarter of 1996, 1.62 billion rupees," it said.
Total first-quarter export proceeds including domestic exports, re-exports and ship's stores and bunkers amounted to 6.79 billion rupees, up 71.0 million rupees, or 1.1 percent, from a year ago.
It said said exports by country of destination showed European Union countries as main buyers, taking 75-percent of Mauritius exports.
"The United Kingdom remained the main buyer with 36 percent of Mauritius total exports," it said.
The import bill reached 8.81 billion rupees, a one-percent increase from 8.72 billion rupees in the corresponding 1996 period. ($1=21.829 Mauritius rupees)
